Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to dataiku.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about Dataiku's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
Dataiku describes itself as "the Platform for AI Success," positioning its core product as a unified system for enterprise AI that combines people, data orchestration, and governance workflows. The platform is designed to move organizations away from manual processes such as spreadsheets and legacy desktop tools toward governed, AI-assisted data pipelines, with features covering data science collaboration, MLOps, and audit-ready oversight including cost controls and unified visibility. The company notes EU-hosted options and GDPR relevance as part of its offering.

Dataiku cites several enterprise deployments on its site: Novartis using the platform's LLM Mesh capability for healthcare market research, Johnson and Johnson's Vision team producing generative AI prototypes within two days through a training and hackathon program, and Michelin applying the platform across R&D, manufacturing, and services at more than 50 global manufacturing sites. For the fifth consecutive year, Dataiku reports being named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Platforms for Data Science and ML, recognized in both "Completeness of Vision" and "Ability to Execute" categories.

A Dataiku and Harris Poll survey of 900 CEOs across eight global markets is cited on the site, with the finding that 80% of CEOs say their role is at risk if their company fails to deliver measurable AI gains by the end of 2026. The held facts record no litigation or MCP server registry presence for the company at this time.
